description: Minified source code for jQuery UI Menu widget version 1.14.1, defining the menu widget, its options, event handlers, and internal methods.

classes.name: ui.menu
classes.description: jQuery UI Menu widget class, providing menu functionality with keyboard and mouse interactions.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the menu widget, sets up event handlers, and prepares the menu element.

methods.name: _activateItem
methods.description: Activates a menu item based on mouse movement.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the menu widget, removing added attributes and elements.

methods.name: _keydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the menu.

methods.name: _activate
methods.description: Activates the selected menu item, expanding submenus or triggering selection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the menu items, icons, and state.

methods.name: _itemRole
methods.description: Returns the ARIA role for menu items based on the widget's role.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets widget options dynamically.

methods.name: _setOptionDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the menu widget.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses a specific menu item.

methods.name: _scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the menu to ensure the active item is visible.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the current menu item.

methods.name: _startOpening
methods.description: Prepares to open a submenu.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Opens a submenu at a specified position.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Closes all open submenus.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes a submenu.

methods.name: _closeOnDocumentClick
methods.description: Determines if clicking outside should close the menu.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the current menu or submenu.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands a submenu.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves focus to the next menu item.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous menu item.

methods.name: isFirstItem
methods.description: Checks if the current item is the first in the menu.

methods.name: isLastItem
methods.description: Checks if the current item is the last in the menu.

methods.name: _menuItems
methods.description: Returns the set of menu items.

methods.name: _move
methods.description: Moves focus in a specified direction.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Moves focus to the next page of menu items.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous page of menu items.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the current menu item.

methods.name: _filterMenuItems
methods.description: Filters menu items based on a search string.
